visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige tank top and dark navy leggings, stands in the center of the frame on a sunlit seaside promenade. She holds a black soprano recorder to her lips, her fingers moving precisely over the holes as she performs. The background is a bright, scenic coastal view featuring a white Mediterranean-style building with a dome, palm trees, and a clear blue ocean under a vast, cloudless sky. Bright natural daylight illuminates her face and the textures of her clothing and the instrument. (2) As she continues to play, she sways her hips slightly to the rhythm of the music. A musical staff and numbered notation overlays are visible in the lower half of the screen, updating as she progresses through the song. Her expression is focused yet serene. Towards the end of the sequence, she completes the melody, lowers the recorder, and offers a slight, pleasant smile toward the camera. The camera remains static throughout the entire performance, maintaining a full-body eye-level shot.
